title: When the self keeps asking to be the center
issueStatement: The room may look calm, but inwardly everything is being measured by injury, credit, image, or control.
centralInsight: Gurbani names haumai as distortion, not confidence. The self swells beyond truth and begins acting like narrator, judge, and owner of the moment.
practicalReflection: Ego rarely announces itself as vanity. More often it appears as defensiveness, comparison, private injury, or the need to keep being right.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self is asking to be confirmed, defended, or admired, and let one of those demands go unanswered today.
